description: Pub. 544 (2025), Ordinary Income Recapture in Like-Kind Exchanges, § 1245: real property (FMV $100,000, basis $50,000) for real property worth $60,000 and $40,000 cash; the § 1245 property given up has a basis of $10,000 and an adjusted basis of $0; received $45,000 of § 1250 and $15,000 of § 1245 property. 'Ordinary income recapture under section 1245(a)(1) 10,000 Gain recognized on like-kind exchange 40,000 Plus: FMV of section 1250 property received 45,000 Section 1245(b)(4) limit $85,000 The lesser of the two amounts ($10,000) recaptured as ordinary income.'
